result.answer: The original schedule is Thursday at 09:30 local time. The currently superseding instruction is Thursday at 10:00 local time: the v2 amendment expressly states that it replaces the time in v1. The Monday/Tuesday creation labels are consistent with v2 being later, but the explicit replacement sentence—not an inferred chronology—is the basis for treating 10:00 as current. These records do not specify a date, timezone, or whether another later amendment exists.

approaches.description: Read v1 as the baseline schedule and apply v2 only because v2 explicitly identifies itself as replacing v1's time.
approaches.reason: The amendment directly supplies both the new time and an express replacement instruction.

approaches.reason: The records provide weekday labels but no full dates; moreover, the explicit replacement clause is the stronger and sufficient basis.
